Step:  
10-01-1370 means 1370-01-10.  
Subtract 6 weeks = 42 days.  
Add 5 days → total subtract 47 days.  

1370-01-10 minus 47 days:  
January 10 → back 10 days to Dec 31, 1369 → remaining 37 days in November/December.  
December has 31 days → 37 - 31 = 6 days left to subtract into November.  
November 30 minus 6 days = November 24, 1369.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1369-11-24
